about.title: About AnimeVerse Intelligence
about.subtitle: Factual intelligence and exploration platform for anime, manga, studios, narratives and adaptations.
about.missionBody: Unify catalog discovery, industrial production networks (StudioGraph), spoiler-safe narrative chronology (LoreGraph) and adaptation fidelity (AdaptationLab) with auditable provenance.
about.pillarCatalog: Catalog & Relations: 38,519 works and 138,093 factual connections without artificial inference.
about.pillarStudios: StudioGraph: analysis of production companies, studios and collaboration networks.
about.pillarLore: LoreGraph: narrative events and causal relations with anti-spoiler enforcement directly in the API.
about.pillarAdaptation: AdaptationLab: episode ↔ chapter mapping where UNKNOWN is never conflated with OMITTED.
about.stack: Angular 22 (Zoneless + Signals + OnPush), Fastify 5, TypeScript 6, PostgreSQL 17 + Drizzle ORM.
about.governance: Missing fields are never fabricated; unclassified links stay UNSPECIFIED; external images are never redistributed without license.
